description: [WRITE] Create a Meta Conversions API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/facebook-tag), imported automatically: the server counterpart of the Meta Pixel. pixelId is the Pixel ID (public, on the web pixel), accessToken the CAPI system-user token. `event` is the Meta event the tag sends (Purchase, Lead, a GA4 name is mapped, or a custom name). User data (em/ph/external_id/IP/user agent), ecommerce custom data and the event_id dedup key are mapped from `ed - …` Event Data variables, which this tool creates in the workspace when they are missing. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: Meta CAPI access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

event.description: Meta event, e.g. "Purchase" / "Lead", or a GA4 name.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Meta CAPI Tag".

name: create_meta_capi_server_tag
